ownerAck.authorizationEffect: This request authorizes preparation only; no generation or ownership claim is made even if acknowledgement appears.

modelPreference: Free/existing included GPT Image 2.5 preferred; current built-in GPT Image 2.0 allowed if 2.5 unavailable. No paid API. No model was invoked during preparation.

contractNotes.outOfCanvasHaloRule: Keep exact 1254 native coordinate frame; top-edge requested halo reaches y=-115 for 8 patches. Valid canvas crop is explicitly recorded. This does not authorize adding exterior panorama or resizing final art.
contractNotes.referenceRule: Before any future image call, re-read AGENTS, inspect confirmed UI primary references and relevant approved layout/actual native south and west boundaries; attach actual required reference images. Preparation does not assert those sources were visually checked.

productionOrder: Eight-core frontier left to right across c04 then c05. Complete r02 subrows 04,03,02,01; then r01 subrows 04,03,02,01. This preserves south and west dependency order.
